title: Clancy Trial Verdict May Hinge on a Single Holdout Juror
description: The jury has been deadlocked since at least Tuesday on whether to hold Lindsay Clancy legally responsible for the strangling deaths of her three children.
author: Jenna Russell, Maia Spoto, Mark Arsenault and Jacey Fortin

title: North Carolina Set to Mail The Fall’s First Ballots As Trump Tries to Restrict Them
description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Postal Service rule that could impede millions of mail voters. The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to weigh in.
author: Emily Davies

title: ‘I Don’t Want to Die This Way’: Stranded for 15 Hours at Sea
description: Two longtime friends rented jet skis for an hourlong excursion. They ended up fighting for their lives.
author: Corina Knoll and Ariana Drehsler

title: A Paralympian Takes His Shot Despite Republicans’ Home Court Advantage
description: Josh Turek is trying to turn deep-red Iowa blue as he runs for the U.S. Senate.
author: Michael Kruse and KC McGinnis

title: ‘Choosin’ Texas’ Is a Southern Hit. Just Don’t Call Texas Southern.
description: Ella Langley’s hit has become an anthem in Austin, a singalong in Nashville and a case study in how the Texas brand travels.
author: Sasha von Oldershausen and Emily Cochrane

title: Burning Man Draws an Older, Wealthier Crowd, Data Shows
description: Last year, just one in ten festivalgoers was in their 20s, according to researchers. A decade ago, the same group represented nearly 30 percent of attendees.
author: Neil Vigdor

title: Missouri Supreme Court Delivers Win for Democrats in Redistricting Case
description: The court said a map redrawn to benefit Republicans could not be used in November and said voters should decide on the new boundaries. The state attorney general vowed to appeal the decision.
author: Mitch Smith

title: Here’s the latest.
description: Here’s the latest.
author: Jenna Russell, Maia Spoto, Mark Arsenault and Jacey Fortin

title: Judge Ends Federal Oversight of Teamsters
description: The union and federal prosecutors agreed that organized crime groups had been rooted out of union operations, the judge wrote.
author: Rebecca Davis O’Brien

title: Trump Taps Army Engineering Official as Acting Secretary
description: The move came days after the resignation of Daniel P. Driscoll, who had clashed with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the purge of top generals in the Army.
author: Chris Cameron

title: ICE Agent Charged With Lying About Minnesota Shooting
description: The charges are a rare instance of President Trump’s Justice Department accusing a federal agent of breaking the law while on the job.
author: Ernesto Londoño and Mitch Smith

title: Trump to Break Ground on Arch Before Getting Approval
description: Doug Burgum, the interior secretary, announced plans to start work on the site of the 250-foot-tall triumphal arch. Final approval of the project is still pending.
author: Luke Broadwater and Emily Badger

title: Minneapolis Shooting Began During a Custody Exchange, Officials Said
description: The gunman, who killed two people and wounded several others at an apartment building, died in an exchange of gunfire with the police, authorities said on Thursday.
author: Christina Morales, Ernesto Londoño and Jeff Ernst

title: Man Is Sentenced in Explosion of Hyperbaric Chamber That Killed a 5-Year-Old
description: The former safety manager of a Michigan alternative health care center will spend at least 19 months in jail in connection with the January 2025 death.
author: Alena Cerro

title: Holdout Juror Throws the Clancy Murder Case Into Disarray
description: The five-week case looked set to end, until the jury sent a note saying that a member refused to recognize the proper definition of reasonable doubt. The defense lawyer said an inquiry was planned for Friday morning.
author: Maia Spoto and Mark Arsenault

title: Candidate Accused of Plotting to Plant Drugs on His Opponent
description: The narrow winner of the Republican primary for a Missouri House seat faces a federal charge.
author: Billy Witz

title: Trump Administration Asks Supreme Court to Allow Mail Voting Limits
description: The justices have been asked to weigh in again on the Trump administration’s efforts to restrict mail voting — this time on whether the plans violate the Constitution.
author: Abbie VanSickle

title: Slava Veder, Whose Camera Captured a Defining Vietnam Homecoming, Dies at 99
description: His Pulitzer-winning photograph, “Burst of Joy,” documented an Air Force pilot’s reunion with his family after five years as a prisoner of war in Vietnam.
author: Jeré Longman

title: Judge Suggests Trump Mail-In Voting Rules Could Cause ‘Major Disenfranchisement’
description: Judge Indira Talwani said the Postal Service appeared to be trying a haphazard “experiment” with a new rule that could result in valid ballots being tossed.
author: Zach Montague

title: Proposal for White House Visitor Screening Center Advances
description: A federal panel again paved the way for one of President Trump’s construction projects, even as it heard opposition to another proposal to fence in a park north of the White House.
author: Aishvarya Kavi
